summary: AITO's new M8 unveiled three selectable configurations, BYD's Titanium 7 surpassed 300,000 units in annual sales, a wave of value-for-money new energy vehicles launched in quick succession, and AI-native vehicles and accessible safety have emerged as the industry's new focal points.

articles.title: AITO New M8 Reveals Max, Max+ and Ultra Trims; Configuration Selection Now Open
articles.summary: The AITO New M8 has launched three configurations — Max, Max+, and Ultra — now open for customer selection, further rounding out the brand's product lineup.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, AITO has officially unveiled three configuration versions of the New M8 — Max, Max+, and Ultra — with selection open starting today. As the brand's core model in the mid-to-large new-energy SUV segment, the New M8 uses a three-tier configuration strategy to cover different budgets and needs: the Max focuses on essential smart features and comfort, the Max+ upgrades smart driving and cabin experience, while the Ultra targets users seeking advanced autonomous driving and a premium experience. The trim naming follows AITO's existing product system for easy understanding and comparison. The opening of configuration selection indicates the new model has entered the final stage before deliveries begin, allowing customers to lock in their preferred version. In the fiercely contested mid-to-large SUV segment, where rivals such as the Li Auto L series and Xiaomi are expanding aggressively, AITO's three-trim approach aims to sustain the sales momentum of the M9 and M7.
articles.impact: The three-tier configuration strategy spans different price bands and will intensify competition in the mid-to-large new-energy SUV market, offering consumers richer and more precise choices in the 300,000-yuan family SUV category.

articles.title: BYD Titanium 7 Surpasses 300,000 Sales in First Year; 27,000 Sold Overseas in Six Months
articles.summary: BYD's Titanium 7 has exceeded 300,000 cumulative sales in its first year on the market, with overseas sales reaching 27,000 in six months, marking strong performance.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, BYD's Titanium 7 has surpassed 300,000 cumulative sales within a year of its launch, becoming another blockbuster product in the new energy vehicle market. Overseas performance has also been impressive, with six-month sales reaching 27,000 units. The annual sales volume of 300,000 units means stable monthly sales of over 25,000, placing it in the top tier of its segment. Against the backdrop of rising new energy penetration rates in China, the Titanium 7 has ramped up quickly thanks to its product positioning, pricing strategy, and BYD's vertically integrated supply chain advantages. The 27,000 overseas units sold in six months show that its global expansion strategy is bearing fruit, with overseas markets emerging as a new growth curve for BYD. Dual-track growth in exports and domestic sales has also further strengthened BYD's economies of scale and brand premium.
articles.impact: The Titanium 7's dual-market performance underscores BYD's scale advantages, putting simultaneous pricing and volume pressure on rivals in the same segment and accelerating Chinese brands' overseas expansion.

articles.title: 2027 Dongfeng eπ 007 Launches at 109,900 Yuan Limited-Time Price with 675km Electric Range
articles.summary: The 2027 Dongfeng eπ 007 has launched with a limited-time starting price of 109,900 yuan and a 675km electric range, offering strong value for money.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, the 2027 Dongfeng eπ 007 has officially launched with a limited-time starting price of 109,900 yuan and a pure-electric range of 675km. The new model is making simultaneous gains on the two core dimensions of price and range: the 109,900-yuan limited-time starting price has dropped into mainstream A-segment ICE territory, while the 675km range ranks among the best in its price bracket, directly easing range anxiety. As Dongfeng's new energy brand, eπ is accelerating its push into the 100,000–150,000-yuan electric sedan market with a high-spec, low-price strategy. This price range is one of the fastest-growing and most competitive segments in the new energy market, where BYD, Geely, and XPeng all have multiple offerings. The limited-time pricing also reflects the promotional tactics commonly used by automakers during the year-end sales drive.
articles.impact: A 675km range breaking into the 100,000-yuan price band will further squeeze rivals in the ICE and budget EV space, accelerating the electrification shift in the A-segment market.

articles.title: 700 TOPS Intelligent Driving Compute: Dongfeng Aeolus L8+ Launches at 129,900 Yuan
articles.summary: Dongfeng Aeolus L8+ launches at a starting price of 129,900 yuan, featuring a 700 TOPS intelligent driving system.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, the Dongfeng Aeolus L8+ has officially launched at a starting price of 129,900 yuan, with its biggest highlight being a smart driving hardware platform delivering 700 TOPS of computing power. Compute at the 700 TOPS level previously appeared mostly in vehicles priced above 200,000 yuan; bringing it down to the 120,000-yuan price point marks the rapid popularization of advanced intelligent driving hardware. In line with Dongfeng's stated goal of making safety and intelligent technology widely accessible, the Aeolus L8+ uses hardware redundancy to leave room for future OTA upgrades and higher-level features. In the 120,000–150,000-yuan SUV market, intelligent driving capability is gradually replacing powertrain and cabin space as a key purchase decision factor. The Aeolus L8+'s pricing and configuration combination also reflects Dongfeng's strategy of trading technology features for market share during its new energy transition.
articles.impact: High-compute intelligent driving hardware reaching the 120,000-yuan tier will drive mass adoption of smart driving features and force rivals at the same price point to upgrade their own intelligent driving offerings.

articles.title: ID. ERA 5S Off to Strong Start; Max Version at 119,900 Yuan Becomes Best-Seller
articles.summary: The ID. ERA 5S has seen strong sales since launch, with the Max version at 119,900 yuan emerging as the volume driver of the lineup.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, the ID. ERA 5S has shown active market performance since launch, with the Max version becoming the lineup's best-selling model at a price of 119,900 yuan. From a sales-mix perspective, the Max version has captured concentrated buyer interest thanks to its balance of price and features, indicating that today's new energy vehicle buyers prioritize the combination of value and practical equipment rather than simply opting for the cheapest entry-level version or the top-of-the-line trim. The ID. ERA series is entering the mainstream pure-electric market in the 110,000–130,000-yuan price band, facing intense competition from domestic brands. The Max version's strong sales also provide a clear market signal for future production planning and configuration adjustments, and it is expected to become the priority for capacity allocation. The rebound of joint-venture and new joint-venture brands in this price segment suggests their localization and product planning capabilities are improving.
articles.impact: The strong sales of a single configuration version reflect mainstream consumers' focus on value for money, prompting automakers to streamline SKUs and concentrate on breakout configurations to improve scale efficiency.

articles.title: New Ford Edge L: More Comfortable, Smarter and More Efficient — Still a Hit with the Whole Family
articles.summary: The new Ford Edge L delivers upgrades in comfort, intelligence and efficiency, targeting family users across all driving scenarios.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, the new Ford Edge L brings simultaneous upgrades across three dimensions — comfort, smart features and efficiency — continuing to focus on the family user market. As Chongqing Ford's pillar model in the mid-to-large SUV segment, the Edge L has traditionally offered a spacious cabin, flexible seating layouts and American-style chassis tuning. The new version builds on those strengths by enhancing the smart cockpit and driver-assist functions, while also optimizing powertrain fuel economy to lower long-term ownership costs for families. With new-energy SUVs increasingly squeezing the joint-venture fuel SUV market, Ford has chosen to maintain competitiveness through product upgrades rather than simple price cuts, demonstrating its continued commitment to the mid-to-large family SUV segment. The Edge L's target users are highly sensitive to space, comfort and reliability, and the upgrade direction aligns well with those demands.
articles.impact: Joint-venture fuel SUVs are countering the new-energy wave with smarter, more efficient upgrades, offering options for family buyers who still prefer gasoline vehicles and slowing segment attrition.

articles.title: Changan CS75 PLUS Blue Whale Super Engine Records Just 3.6L/100km in Real-World Testing
articles.summary: Real-world tests show the Changan CS75 PLUS Blue Whale Super Engine variant achieving fuel consumption as low as 3.6L per 100km, a standout in efficiency.
articles.detail: According to real-world test data from NetEase Auto, the Changan CS75 PLUS Blue Whale Super Engine variant achieved a tested fuel consumption of 3.6L/100km. The Blue Whale powertrain is Changan's self-developed core engine system; the Super Engine variant has significantly cut fuel consumption through optimized combustion efficiency, upgraded thermal management and improved transmission matching — all while maintaining strong power output. A figure of 3.6L/100km is exceptionally good for a compact SUV, and even accounting for potentially favorable test conditions, its efficiency potential remains impressive. The CS75 PLUS has long ranked among the top-selling domestic compact SUVs, with powertrain economy being one of its core selling points. As hybrid and pure-electric models penetrate the market rapidly, efficient gasoline powertrains remain a key choice for a large number of buyers in cities without license-plate restrictions.
articles.impact: Ultra-low real-world fuel consumption strengthens the economic competitiveness of gasoline SUVs, giving consumers who have not yet switched to new energy a more practical reason to buy.

articles.title: Exclusive Interview with Jiang Ping: No Safety Tiering — Changan Aims to Make Safety Tech Accessible to All
articles.summary: Changan Auto's Jiang Ping says safety features should not be split between trim levels, pledging to make safety technology standard across its entire lineup.
articles.detail: In an exclusive interview with NetEase Auto, Changan Auto's Jiang Ping outlined the company's principle of avoiding safety tiering, vowing to make safety technology universally accessible across its full product range rather than reserving it for higher trims. The remarks strike at a long-standing industry pain point: many automakers use active safety systems, airbag counts, and body structure as differentiators between trim levels, compromising safety performance on entry-level models. Changan's inclusive approach means even lower-priced volume models will come standard with core safety technology, restoring safety from a selling point to a non-negotiable baseline. This follows Changan's recent move to equip models such as the Fengshen L8+ with 700 TOPS computing power for intelligent driving, reflecting a broader strategy of pushing technology and safety features down the lineup to win consumer trust and market share. If implemented, the approach could set a benchmark that pressures the industry on equipment strategy.
articles.impact: Standardizing safety features across all models will raise the industry's safety baseline, forcing rivals to abandon trim-based safety differentiation and ultimately benefiting entry-level consumers.

articles.title: CCTV Interview with AIVA's Li Bo: Breaking Down the Product Logic of AI-Native Vehicles
articles.summary: CCTV interviews AIVA's Li Bo to unpack the product definition logic and technical architecture behind AI-native vehicles.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, CCTV conducted an in-depth interview with AIVA's Li Bo on the product logic of AI-native vehicles. An AI-native vehicle refers to one redesigned from the ground up around artificial intelligence — from product definition and electronic/electrical architecture to software systems — rather than a traditional model with AI features layered on top. Li Bo explained how AI-native vehicles differ in interaction models, feature iteration, and user experience, emphasizing that AI capabilities will evolve from an assistive tool into a core product strength. CCTV's coverage itself signals that the convergence of AI and the automotive industry has risen to the agenda of mainstream media and industrial policy. With multiple automakers and tech companies racing on large-model integration, smart cockpits, and unified autonomous driving solutions, the AI-native concept offers the industry a new framework for product definition.
articles.impact: Mainstream adoption of the AI-native concept will reshape automotive product definition logic, pushing automakers from hardware competition toward AI software capability competition and accelerating industry consolidation.

articles.title: DeepSeek Unveils New Agent Architecture: AI Directing AI Could Reshape Smart Cockpits
articles.summary: DeepSeek has launched a new Agent architecture in which AI begins directing AI to collaborate on tasks, a shift poised to deeply impact automotive intelligence.
articles.detail: According to Baidu Hot Search, DeepSeek has unveiled a major new Agent architecture enabling a paradigm where AI directs AI to get work done, with multiple agents dividing labor and collaborating to complete complex tasks. While not directly an automotive story, the breakthrough carries profound implications for the car industry: multi-agent collaborative architectures can be introduced into smart cockpits and autonomous driving systems, allowing voice assistants, vehicle control, navigation and driving strategy modules to work together autonomously as agents — users issue a single instruction, and the system automatically decomposes and dispatches tasks internally. Combined with the AI-native automotive product logic presented today by AIVA's Li Bo, large language models and Agent capabilities are becoming the underlying variables shaping competition in the next generation of intelligent vehicles. Rapid iteration in domestic AI technology also supplies the technical foundation for Chinese brands to lead in smart cockpits and human-machine interaction.
articles.impact: Mature Agent architectures will accelerate the shift of smart cockpits from passive response to proactive service, giving domestic brands new tools to build software-based differentiation.

articles.title: Year-End Sales Push Begins: Value for Money and Technology for All to Define Next Phase of Competition
articles.summary: Multiple new models are entering the market with limited-time low prices and advanced configurations, while policy support boosts auto consumption — year-end competition is set to heat up further.
articles.detail: Across today's news, the 2027 Yipai 007 is on sale from 109,900 yuan for a limited time, the Fengshen L8+ packs 700 TOPS intelligent-driving compute at 129,900 yuan, and the ID. ERA 5S Max at 119,900 yuan has become a bestseller. New models are broadly launching with high specs at low prices, and combined with earlier national policy moves to expand auto consumption across the entire value chain, the price and configuration battle of the year-end volume push has officially begun. Meanwhile, Changan has championed a philosophy of democratizing safety regardless of trim level, and BYD's Tai 7 is ramping up sales both domestically and internationally — signs that leading automakers are building moats through scale effects and technology trickle-down. Looking ahead, the 100,000–150,000 yuan mainstream price segment is expected to become the most fiercely contested battleground for NEVs and fuel vehicles alike. The rollout of intelligent-driving compute, driving range and safety features will accelerate, and the survival space for weaker brands will continue to shrink.
articles.impact: Dual democratization of price and technology will benefit consumers while accelerating industry consolidation, with smaller brands lacking scale and technological depth facing greater pressure to exit the market.
